title: Outer Mines
description: This is a Minecraft survival mod heavily inspired by the game Outer Wilds. You can fly a ship, solve puzzles, and defeat a monster in a custom dimension.
body: **Outer Mines** is a passion project inspired by the mystery of *Outer Wilds*, reimagined for Minecraft. You’ll explore strange mechanics, solve hand-crafted puzzles, and uncover a hidden portal to the Outer Mines, a dangerous cosmic realm filled with hostile Stardragon fish, unstable gravity, and terrifying black holes. The mod is currently in **early alpha**, so expect rough edges, bugs, and unfinished features. The Outer Mines are still evolving, and feedback is welcome as the universe takes shape. Use BSL Shader for the world curvature effect. Integrated curvature will come soon!
